result:
I've opened PR #614 with the fix. Summary while CI runs:

**Finding:** The Excel BoQ importer failed badly against the real prospect file structure — all 9 real task/sub-task rows were dropped, leaving only 2 garbage "category label" rows (qty=0, rate=0). Root causes: `"Sl No"` wasn't recognized as an itemCode alias, and column-mapping picked the `"Category"` column over `"Description (Task)"` purely by sheet-position rather than alias specificity, plus there was no handling at all for unlabeled sub-task rows.

**Fix:** Reworked `mapBoqHeaders` to resolve by alias priority instead of header position, added missing aliases, added a `subTask` fallback column, and added positional parent-inference for sub-task rows lacking their own itemCode — all confined to the import/parsing layer, `computeHierarchicalAmount()` untouched.

**Verified:** `tsc --noEmit` clean, new regression test passes (6/6), downstream `construction-boq-service.test.ts` unaffected (19/19). PR #614 pushed; CI is running now — I'll check back once it completes.
